content.title: Ford sales rose 6% in 2025, hybrid vehicles drive growth
content.description:
Ford (F) reported that its US auto sales increased by 6% annually in 2025, driven by a mix of hybrid vehicles and affordable models for first-time buyers.

Yahoo Finance senior autos reporter Pras Subramanian breaks down Ford's latest sales data, while taking a look at how Chinese EV maker BYD (BYDDY, 1211.HK) outsold Tesla (TSLA) in 2025.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: The $160,000 Mechanic Job That Ford Can’t Fill
content.summary: KENT, Ohio—Just after 7 a.m. on a recent morning, Ted Hummel leapt up onto the front bumper of a 2019 Ford F-150 and reached under the hood to disconnect a pair of oxygen sensor connectors.  Hummel is confident he can do it in half the time.  Most mechanics at the Klaben Ford dealership in Kent, Ohio, hate messing with transmissions, the duffel-bag-shaped, 300-pound machines that transfer power to the vehicles’ wheels.
